#   War-risk cost is EMBEDDED in the freight a charterer pays, so TD6 moves continuously where the AWRP moves discretely. It does NOT isolate the war-risk component — freight also carries tightness, tonnage availability and voyage economics — so TD6 is a CONTINUOUS PROXY, never a substitute for a rate print.
